description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this excellent three-bedroom extended family home, ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac location within the popular Saint John’s Wood West development in Clondalkin, Dublin 22. The property enjoys a particularly attractive position overlooking a large green area to the front, offering a pleasant outlook and a safe, family-friendly setting. The accommodation has been extended to the rear, providing additional living space and making this an ideal home for growing families or buyers seeking a property with excellent potential. Upon entering, the welcoming accommodation comprises a porch, entrance hall, a bright lounge area, to the rear of the property is a modern kitchen, cum dining room, that opens onto the extension leading to a bright and spacious living area, with the extended rear accommodation providing valuable additional space for modern family living. Upstairs there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom. To the rear there is a west-facing garden that has a shed that is also wired for electricity, an excellent feature providing plenty of afternoon and evening sunshine. The property further benefits from gas-fired central heating, an alarm system and the significant advantage of being offered for sale with no onward chain, allowing for a smoother and potentially quicker purchase. Saint John’s Wood West is a well-established and highly regarded residential development, ideally located close to a wide range of local amenities. Clondalkin Village, schools, shops, parks, leisure facilities and public transport links are all within easy reach, while the M50 motorway provides excellent access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. Early viewing is highly recommended. 

Contact Shauna O’Brien of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
